# `widget/dist/` — built output (generated)

## Summary

The widget as customers load it, written by `npm run build` in `widget/` and
committed so the `widget-bundle-size` oracle and the deploy read it from the repo.
Generated by `widget/vite.config.ts` — never edit a file here by hand; rebuild.

## File Index

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `widget.js` | ESM entry bundle — the `<script type="module">` customers embed. |
| `redact.js` | Lazily fetched screenshot-redaction chunk. |
| `widget.css` | The widget's styles, loaded with `<link>`. |
| `locales/` | One lazily fetched catalog chunk per non-English locale (`<code>.js`, Contract C42). |
